critique.evidence: Keyboard navigation reaches the arena through the horizontal scroller; the skip-link target measures 158×46 px; no touch-target violations or viewport overflow were measured at 1440, 768, or 390 px; and reduced-motion produced no transform or opacity animation. However, accessibility proof is unresolved across every viewport: color contrast is incomplete for 553 desktop, 508 tablet, and 484 mobile nodes; 6 nodes have serious prohibited-ARIA findings; and 2 nodes have critical duplicate ARIA/label IDs. Zero reported violations does not override these incomplete checks.
critique.fix: Measure and correct every flagged foreground/background contrast pair to WCAG AA, remove prohibited ARIA attributes, and make all IDs referenced by ARIA or labels unique. Re-run automated checks until these results are verified passes, then add arena-specific screen-reader semantics and visible-focus evidence for the chart, phylogeny controls, survivor disclosure, and vaccination sequence.
